procedures.gauge: two 3 mm balls 10.000 mm apart; 5 presses at 2 N with random offsets/yaw; distance between the two contact centroids (weighted, reconstructed depth > 30 % of peak); presses whose two contacts differ in area by > 30 % are rejected; median over the presses
procedures.displacement: 5 mm calibration ball; 3x3 grid of sensor offsets (+-5 x +-4 mm, robot repeatability sigma 0.02 mm); affine fit of contact centroid (px) vs commanded offset (mm)

structured_noise: illumination drift 4 %, gel texture 2 grey levels
